findings.title: Layer isolation violation: Web project directly references Infrastructure layer
findings.rule_violated: Clean Architecture: Dependency Rule (Web should only depend on Core + Services, not Infrastructure)
findings.remediation: Move all Infrastructure initialization (EF Core, SQLite init) into the Services layer's DI extension method (ServiceCollectionExtensions.AddContestJudgingServices). Remove the ProjectReference to Infrastructure from Web.csproj and the EF Core/SQLite PackageReferences. Web should only reference Services (and Core for entities).

findings.title: E2E test project not included in solution file
findings.evidence_snippet: tests/ContestJudging.E2ETests/ContestJudging.E2ETests.csproj exists on disk but the .slnx file contains no reference to it.
findings.rule_violated: Solution Completeness (all buildable projects must be in the solution)
findings.remediation: Add a <Project Path="tests/ContestJudging.E2ETests/ContestJudging.E2ETests.csproj" /> entry to ContestJudging.slnx under the /tests/ folder. Or remove the project directory if the E2E tests are intentionally excluded.

findings.title: E2E tests reference packages not declared in Directory.Packages.props (central package management violation)
findings.evidence_snippet:
<!-- E2ETests.csproj lines 15-17 -->
<PackageReference Include="NUnit" />
<PackageReference Include="NUnit.Analyzers" />
<PackageReference Include="NUnit3TestAdapter" />
<PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Playwright.NUnit" />

<!-- Directory.Packages.props has no matching <PackageVersion> for any of these -->
findings.rule_violated: Central Package Management: all PackageReference items must have a corresponding PackageVersion in Directory.Packages.props when ManagePackageVersionsCentrally is true
findings.remediation: Add <PackageVersion> entries for NUnit, NUnit.Analyzers, NUnit3TestAdapter, and Microsoft.Playwright.NUnit to Directory.Packages.props. Example: <PackageVersion Include="NUnit" Version="4.3.2" />. This is build-breaking.

findings.title: E2ETests project missing explicit RootNamespace and AssemblyName properties
findings.rule_violated: Project Convention Consistency (all projects should use explicit RootNamespace/AssemblyName)
findings.remediation: Add <RootNamespace>ContestJudging.E2ETests</RootNamespace> and <AssemblyName>ContestJudging.E2ETests</AssemblyName> to the E2ETests.csproj PropertyGroup.

findings.title: Orphaned scaffolding placeholder file in Infrastructure project
Mixed test frameworks across test projects
findings.rule_violated: Testing Consistency (single test framework per solution is standard practice)
findings.remediation: Either convert E2E tests to xUnit (matching the unit test project) or document the rationale for two frameworks. If E2E tests use NUnit for Playwright integration, add a note in the project README.

findings.title: .gitignore missing SQLite database file patterns
findings.rule_violated: Git Hygiene (build/runtime artifacts should be gitignored)
findings.remediation: Add '*.db', '*.sqlite', and '*.sqlite3' patterns to .gitignore to prevent accidentally committing SQLite database files.

findings.title: Redundant TargetFramework/Nullable/ImplicitUsings overrides in Web.csproj
findings.rule_violated: DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) / Build configuration conventions
findings.remediation: Remove the TargetFramework, Nullable, and ImplicitUsings properties from Web.csproj's PropertyGroup; rely on Directory.Build.props inheritance. Same applies to E2ETests.csproj.

findings.title: Orphaned testapp scaffold project outside solution
findings.remediation: Delete the entire testapp/ directory if it's a scaffolding artifact. If it serves a purpose, add it to the solution and conform it to project conventions (central package management, namespace naming).

findings.title: Trim analyzer enabled globally but EF Core (Infrastructure) is not trimming-safe
findings.rule_violated: Build Configuration (trim settings should be scoped to the published project, not class libraries)
findings.remediation: Move <IsTrimmable> and <EnableTrimAnalyzer> from Directory.Build.props into the Web.csproj PropertyGroup. Class libraries (Core, Infrastructure, Services) should not be marked trimmable since the consuming app controls trimming. Or scope with a Condition="'$(IsPublishable)' == 'true'".
